name: HireSmart approved knowledge base
owner: HR Project Lead (draft by Ansh Raj)
note: Answers are drafts pending HR approval. Text in [square brackets] needs HR input. Synthetic scenario.

faq.question: What happens after I apply?
faq.answer: You should receive an acknowledgement. The recruitment team reviews your application against the job-related criteria published for the role and shares updates when available.

faq.question: How long does the hiring process take?
faq.answer: Our target is to complete hiring in 38 days or less. Actual timelines vary by role and interview availability.

faq.question: Can I apply for more than one role?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the published requirements for each role. Tailor your application to the relevant position.

faq.question: Can I update my application?
faq.answer: Contact the recruitment team with your application ID and the correction you need. Please do not send sensitive identity documents unless they are formally requested through an approved channel.

faq.question: How do I request an accommodation?
faq.answer: Contact the designated HR representative privately. Your request is handled confidentially and does not affect the job-related assessment.

faq.question: What interview formats are used?
faq.answer: A role may include a structured interview, a practical exercise or a skills discussion. The recruiter explains the format in advance.

faq.question: Will I receive feedback if rejected?
faq.answer: Where feasible, the team gives brief job-related feedback. Detailed feedback is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can I reschedule an interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell the recruiter as early as possible and suggest alternative times.

faq.question: What should I prepare for a technical interview?
faq.answer: Review the job description and be ready to discuss relevant work, your problem-solving steps and the trade-offs you considered.

faq.question: Is a portfolio mandatory?
faq.answer: Only when the job description says it is required. Otherwise it is optional supporting evidence.

faq.question: How is my application assessed?
faq.answer: Reviewers use job-related criteria published for the role. A human makes the decisions; any AI output is advisory only.

faq.question: Does the company use AI in recruitment?
faq.answer: AI tools may help summarize applications and answer routine questions. Final decisions are always made by authorized people.

faq.question: What candidate data is collected?
faq.answer: Only the information needed for the recruitment process, handled under approved policies and applicable law.

faq.question: How long is candidate data retained?
faq.answer: Data is kept according to the company’s approved retention schedule. [HR to insert the approved retention period before publication.]

faq.question: Who can see my application?
faq.answer: Only authorized recruitment and hiring staff who have a legitimate need.

faq.question: Can I ask for my data to be corrected?
faq.answer: Yes. Contact the HR privacy contact or your recruiter to request a correction through the approved process.

faq.question: What if I receive no update?
faq.answer: Contact your recruiter with your application ID. Our service target is a status update within three business days, where possible.

faq.question: What does offer acceptance mean?
faq.answer: It means you have formally accepted an offer under the company’s documented process.

faq.question: Can an offer be negotiated?
faq.answer: Contact the recruiter to discuss compensation or other terms. Please do not share sensitive financial information in a public channel.

faq.question: What documents are needed after selection?
faq.answer: HR will send an approved checklist. Submit documents only through authorized secure channels.

faq.question: When will I receive my joining details?
faq.answer: The onboarding contact shares joining logistics before your start date.

faq.question: Who helps with laptop or account access?
faq.answer: Use the onboarding help channel in your welcome message. If an access issue is not resolved, contact your assigned onboarding owner.

faq.question: What happens on Day 1?
faq.answer: Expect an orientation, access checks, team introductions and an overview of what your role expects, adjusted for the role.

faq.question: Will I have an onboarding buddy?
faq.answer: Where team capacity allows. Confirm with your manager or HR contact.

faq.question: How are first-month goals set?
faq.answer: Your manager agrees role-specific priorities and success measures with you during onboarding.

faq.question: Where can I find HR policies?
faq.answer: In the approved employee knowledge base. If two documents conflict, ask HR to confirm the current version.

faq.question: How do I report workplace harassment?
faq.answer: Contact the designated HR contact or the formal reporting channel straight away. This is a sensitive matter and a person will handle it.

faq.question: How do I raise a payroll issue?
faq.answer: Contact the authorized payroll or HR team through the official confidential channel.

faq.question: Can the chatbot give legal or medical advice?
faq.answer: No. It gives approved general information only. For personal legal, medical or safety matters, contact qualified support; HR can point you to the right person.

faq.question: What if the answer seems incorrect?
faq.answer: Ask for a human HR representative and tell them which FAQ topic or answer needs review.

faq.question: Can I get a copy of the job description?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the careers page or ask the recruiter for the current approved version.

faq.question: What does 'must-have' mean?
faq.answer: A skill or requirement genuinely needed to perform the essential duties of the role.

faq.question: What does 'nice-to-have' mean?
faq.answer: A helpful skill that is not required for you to be considered for the role.

faq.question: Are referrals guaranteed an interview?
faq.answer: No. Referred applications are assessed against the same job-related criteria as every other application.

faq.question: Does the company prefer a particular college?
faq.answer: No. We assess relevant skills and evidence, not college prestige.

faq.question: Can AI reject my application automatically?
faq.answer: No. AI may help organize evidence, but a human reviews every decision.

faq.question: How can I request an accessibility adjustment?
faq.answer: Contact HR privately through the approved accommodation process. Share only the information needed to arrange the adjustment.

faq.question: Can I withdraw my application?
faq.answer: Yes. Contact the recruiter or use the official application channel.

faq.question: What is the status of my application right now?
faq.answer: This assistant cannot see live application records. Please contact your recruiter with your application ID.

faq.question: How can I contact a human?
faq.answer: Use the recruiter or HR contact in your application or onboarding email. If you cannot reach them, send a request through the careers page.

policy_statements.question: Will a career gap hurt my application?
policy_statements.answer: No. A career gap alone does not lower an assessment. We assess job-related evidence only.
policy_statements.source: Fair-hiring statement in the job descriptions

policy_statements.question: How many years of experience do I need?
policy_statements.answer: Job descriptions list must-have skills rather than a minimum number of years. Read the must-have list for the role and apply if you meet it.
policy_statements.source: Fair-hiring statement in the job descriptions
